prompt:
Goal: (11,1). Coordinates are (column, row). Lower row numbers are higher on the map.
If your row is 1 and column is less than 7, answer RIGHT.
If your column is 7 and row is less than 7, answer DOWN.
If your row is 7 and column is less than 11, answer RIGHT.
If your column is 11 and row is more than 1, answer UP.
If none of these match, move toward row 1.
